hero.name: Mathieu Souli
hero.tagline: I turn satellite data into decisions.
hero.description: Geoinformation engineer specialized in remote sensing, GIS, and GeoAI, I build full-stack solutions that leverage spatial data at scale — from satellite imagery analysis to production-ready web, mobile, and desktop applications.

about.title: About
about.bio: Engineering student in Geoinformation at FST Tangier (Abdelmalek Essaâdi University), I specialize in GeoAI — machine learning and deep learning applied to geospatial data —, spatial Big Data analysis, remote sensing, and the development of location-based web and mobile applications. My path has taken me from cleaning cadastral data with AutoCAD and QGIS at Burkina Faso's Directorate General of Taxes, to building Water Credit AI, a geospatial platform combining Sentinel-2 imagery, NDVI indices, and machine learning, presented at the UNESCO Water4Future Hackathon. I'm currently looking for a 2-month final-year internship to apply these skills to projects with real territorial or environmental impact.
